question: 总销售额是多少
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders LIMIT 1000

question: 各地区的订单数量排名
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS 订单量 FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY 订单量 DESC LIMIT 1000

question: 上个月销售额
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) LIMIT 1000

question: 退货订单
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded' LIMIT 1000

question: 销售额超过10万的地区
sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) > 100000 LIMIT 1000

question: 企业类型客户下了多少笔交易
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.user_id = c.id WHERE c.type = '企业' LIMIT 1000

question: 数码类商品总共卖出去了多少件
sql: SELECT SUM(o.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = '数码' LIMIT 1000
